messages:
Marina: Auditor Jane requested a compact evidence set linking the invoice spike (INV-2025-03) to API retry activity during 2025-06-10 09:00-10:00 UTC. She needs proof for controls CC6 (key rotation) and CC7 (access logging), plus repro steps.

Leo: Short summary: customer job entered a retry loop causing many generation attempts. There was a scheduled KMS key rotation earlier that morning. Auditor wants timeline and any correlation between retries and KMS operations.

auditor-jane: Please include: - redacted access log rows with request_id and client_id - CloudTrail/KMS audit entries (rotation event, Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) - mapping file request_id -> kms_key_id - a brief repro script and expected response pattern - statement of retention windows for these logs

Eli: I can export the prod-access logs and KMS audit trail. Questions: preferred format (redacted CSV) and delivery? Also will include S3 lifecycle snapshots for retention proof.

Sophia: CSV is good. Auditor likes fields: request_id, client_id (redacted), model_id, kms_key_id, timestamp, response_code, token_count. For repro, a small curl loop hitting /v1/generate on staging with induced backend drop is enough.

Marina: Great. Confirm retention policy please: access logs 365 days, KMS audit exports 730 days. Include exact lifecycle policy lines.

Eli: Confirmed: prod-api-logs lifecycle = 365d, keymaster-cloudtrail = 730d. I'll attach the bucket policy dumps.

Leo: Repro harness (staging) to illustrate retry pattern and token usage — include in packet as 'for auditor use only':

```
# repro-trigger-retries.sh
TOKEN="$STAGING_TOKEN"
for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  curl -i -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood-large","prompt":"test"}' || true
  sleep 1
done
```

Expected: a few 502/503 responses while backend is dropped, then subsequent 200s as workers recover. Capture request_ids from headers and map to billing tokens.

auditor-jane: Also need the KMS rotation artifact showing old_key_id -> new_key_id and proof that decrypts post-rotation used new_key_id.

Eli: Will export CloudTrail events for kms:RotateKey, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey. I'll create a CSV with columns: event_time, event_name, key_id, request_id, principal.

Sophia: Add a short control narrative: key rotation procedure, cache window behavior (2 min buffered decrypts), and why rotation did not create auth failures. This explains why retry spike was caused by job behavior, not key unavailability.

Marina: Action items: 1) Eli exports logs and KMS CSV, 2) Leo prepares billing token breakdown mapping to request_ids, 3) Sophia writes control narrative and includes lifecycle policy screenshots, 4) Marina packages and uploads evidence bundle to evidence S3 by EOD UTC.

deploy-bot: upload complete: s3://redwood-evidence/2025-06-10/INV-2025-03_evidence_bundle.zip :white_check_mark:

auditor-jane: Received. I'll review and follow up if more detail or redaction changes are needed. Thanks.

Leo: If auditor asks for per-request token math, we have billing logs with token_count per request; will attach a sample mapping.

Marina: Marking this thread resolved unless auditor reopens with follow-ups.
